Accumulate N-wide vectors directly in the output ABI array with physical column strideMt+1 to distribute SRAM banks. A map callback, driven by the existing Nt-length weight descriptor, copies each physical column through the Mt-halfword temporary using explicit bank1 DSRs. Extra weight reads remain inside timing; no requested work or layout conversion is omitted.
